mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kpis_information ( id, cycle_id, master_kpi_id, target_description, target_value, weight, is_important, created_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{cycleId}, #{masterKpiId}, #{targetDescription}, #{targetValue}, #{weight}, #{isImportant}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT ki.id AS kpi_information_id, ki.cycle_id, ki.master_kpi_id, km.is_global FROM kpis_information ki INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ki.master_kpi_id WHERE ki.id = #{kpiInfoId} AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL AND km.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ki.id AS kpi_information_id, ki.cycle_id, ki.master_kpi_id, km.is_global FROM kpi_assignments ka INNER JOIN kpis_information ki ON ki.id = ka.kpi_info_id INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ki.master_kpi_id WHERE ka.id = #{assignmentId} AND ka.user_id = #{pmId} AND ka.created_by = #{pmId} AND ka.status_code IN (402, 403, 404, 406) AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ki.created_by = #{pmId} AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL AND km.created_by = #{pmId} AND km.type_code IN (101, 102, 103) AND km.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kpis_information WHERE master_kpi_id = #{masterKpiId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ki.id AS kpi_information_id, ki.cycle_id, ki.master_kpi_id, km.type_code, km.category_id, km.name AS kpi_name, ki.target_description, ki.target_value, ki.weight, ki.is_important, km.unit_code, km.calculation_rule_code, km.calculation_type_code, km.is_global FROM kpis_information ki INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ki.master_kpi_id WHERE ki.id = #{kpiInfoId} AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL AND km.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE kpis_information SET target_description = CAST(#{targetDescription} AS jsonb), target_value = #{targetValue}, weight = #{weight}, is_important = #{isImportant}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{kpiInfoId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT ki.id AS kpi_info_id, km.id AS master_kpi_id, km.code AS kpi_code, km.name AS kpi_name, km.category_id, kc.name AS category_name, km.type_code, km.calculation_rule_code, km.calculation_type_code, km.is_global, ( SELECT cr.code FROM user_roles cur INNER JOIN roles cr ON cr.id = cur.role_id AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE cur.user_id = km.created_by ORDER BY CASE UPPER(TRIM(cr.code)) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END LIMIT 1 ) AS creator_role_code, km.unit_code, ki.weight AS kpi_weight, ki.target_value AS catalog_target_value, ki.target_description AS kpi_target_description, ki.is_important, COALESCE(kas_a.department_id, kas_u.department_id, ud.department_id) AS section_id, COALESCE(kas_a.department_name, kas_u.department_name, d.name) AS section_name, mgr.id AS section_manager_id, mgr.full_name AS section_manager_name, ( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = mgr.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS section_manager_role_code, ( SELECT r.name FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = mgr.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS section_manager_role_name, u.id AS member_id, u.full_name AS member_name, ( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS member_role_code, ( SELECT r.name FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS member_role_name, COALESCE(kas_a.supervisor_id, kas_u.supervisor_id, ud.supervisor_id) AS leader_id, COALESCE(kas_a.supervisor_full_name, kas_u.supervisor_full_name, ldr.full_name) AS leader_name, ( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = ldr.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS leader_role_code, ( SELECT r.name FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = ldr.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS leader_role_name, COALESCE(kas_a.job_title_name, kas_u.job_title_name, jt.name) AS member_rank, ka.id AS assignment_id, ka.parent_assignment_id AS parentAssignmentId, ka.status_code, ka.mid_self_score, ka.end_self_score, ka.end_pm_score, ka.end_gm_score, ( SELECT root.target_value FROM kpi_assignments root WHERE root.cycle_id = ki.cycle_id AND root.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND root.user_id = mgr.id AND root.parent_assignment_id IS NULL AND root.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY root.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS section_assigned_target_value, ka.target_value AS member_target_value, ka.evidences::text AS evidences, kf.feedback_note, NULLIF( TRIM( CONCAT_WS( E'\n', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(uks.evaluation_supervisor_comments, '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(uks.evaluation_supervisor_comments_promotion, '')), '') ) ), '' ) AS evaluation_supervisor_comments, ( SELECT UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) FROM kpi_assignment_feedbacks f INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = f.target_role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE f.assignment_id = ka.id AND f.cycle_id = ka.cycle_id AND f.is_active = TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS active_feedback_target_role_code FROM kpis_information ki INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id, kpi_info_id) id, cycle_id, kpi_info_id, user_id, status_code, mid_self_score, end_self_score, end_pm_score, end_gm_score, target_value, evidences, parent_assignment_id FROM kpi_assignments WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY user_id, kpi_info_id, status_code DESC, created_at DESC ) ka ON ka.cycle_id = ki.cycle_id AND ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id LEFT JOIN kpi_assignment_feedbacks kf ON kf.assignment_id = ka.id AND kf.cycle_id = ka.cycle_id AND kf.target_role_id = ( SELECT r.id FROM roles r WHERE UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) = 'GM' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1 ) AND kf.is_active = TRUE AND kf.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = ka.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_kpi_summaries uks ON uks.user_id = u.id AND uks.cycle_id = ki.cycle_id AND uks.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_departments ud ON ud.user_id = u.id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE LEFT JOIN kpi_assignment_snapshots kas_a ON kas_a.assignment_id = ka.id AND kas_a.cycle_id = ki.cycle_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id, cycle_id) user_id, cycle_id, department_id, department_name, job_title_name, supervisor_id, supervisor_full_name FROM kpi_assignment_snapshots WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId} ORDER BY user_id, cycle_id, created_at ASC ) kas_u ON kas_u.user_id = u.id AND kas_u.cycle_id = ki.cycle_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = COALESCE(kas_a.department_id, kas_u.department_id, ud.department_id) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users mgr ON mgr.id = d.manager_id LEFT JOIN users ldr ON ldr.id = COALESCE(kas_a.supervisor_id, kas_u.supervisor_id, ud.supervisor_id) AND ldr.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN job_titles jt ON jt.id = u.job_title_id AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ki.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY km.code NULLS LAST, km.name, COALESCE(kas_a.department_name, kas_u.department_name, d.name), u.full_name
